source_refs.note: The table of other blood group systems (PDF 92); superscripts are written on the line and 'leb' is read as Le b.

blocks.text: Besides ABO and Rh there are other major blood group systems. These usually do not cause matching problems in blood transfusions.

blocks.caption: Other major blood group systems
rows: K, k, Kp a, Kp b, Js a, Js b

blocks.title: Reading the antigen names
blocks.text: In print the small letters a and b are written as superscripts, for example Lu with a raised a. Here they are written on the line, so 'Lu a' means the Lutheran a antigen.

blocks.prompt: Name two blood group systems other than ABO and Rh.
blocks.explanation: Any two of MNS, Lutheran, Kell, Lewis and Duffy.

items: Other systems: MNS, Lutheran, Kell, Lewis, Duffy; they rarely cause transfusion problems.
